Imported subset: Wolf, original fast walk loop and T_Wolf diffuse texture. The supplied FBX has a combined static display and one separately rigged wolf, not 100 individually animated animals. Changes: selected only wolf; omitted sales-display geometry; converted with Blender 4.3; source walk retained; Unity material/pivot/scale adaptation.
